author: Tsova_Avost
quote: Absolutely disgraceful. Nintendo has apparently decided that the best way to honor one of gaming's most beloved classics is to dig up its corpse, slap a price tag on it, and see how much money they can squeeze out of people who remember having a **** gameplay? Ancient. The innovation? Practically nonexistent. The business model? Apparently, nostalgia is now a renewable resource that can be harvested indefinitely.Rather than investing in genuinely new ideas, we're being served another helping of recycled content with a corporate price tag attached. It's not a reimagining; it's a financial strategy wearing Link's green hat.Somewhere in a boardroom, a group of executives probably congratulated themselves for discovering that people will pay premium prices for something they already own. Truly groundbreaking work. Perhaps the next release will be a remastered remaster, featuring 4K textures, a $20 soundtrack DLC, and the privilege of purchasing Epona **** let's not forget the shareholders. Because apparently, the real final boss isn't Ganondorf. It's the quarterly earnings report.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Tsova_Avost
quote:
Excellent gameplay, a fantastic storyline, and an overall experience that delivers on just about every level. 

But honestly, one of the most satisfying aspects has been watching it absolutely piss off the usual crowd on Twitch. 

The game is genuinely great, and since it doesn't cater to some losers who have never been with a woman - I enjoy it even more. All around, an incredible experience. Rockstar knocked it out of the park.
